example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এতটাই কৃপণ যে তার জল গলে না, কখনো কাউকে এক ফোঁটা জলও দেয় না।
এই লোকটার জল গলে না, তার কাছে যাওয়া বৃথা।
example_sentences_in_english: He is so stingy that water wouldn't melt in his grasp; he wouldn't give even a drop to anyone.
That man's extreme miserliness is proverbial; water doesn't melt for him.
note: The idiom metaphorically describes unyielding stinginess, as if even water remains unmelted, emphasizing refusal to part with anything.
